decisions.reason: As a flagship 2018 launch highlighted on the home page and tightly aligned with the firm's cloud messaging strategy, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly.
It extends the firm's document workflow offering, was given its own page, and fits well with demand for compliant digital process automation among business and public-sector customers.

Although less prominently presented, email and fax conversion complements the firm's multichannel communication portfolio and remains relevant for regulated and legacy-heavy customer environments in Germany.

This is a narrower optimization feature rather than a major standalone product, so it is somewhat more exposed to rationalization, but it still supports the firm's established fax-related service base.
Email sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's secure messaging value proposition and is consistent with customer demand for higher security in critical communications.
Multi-engine email virus scanning is close to the existing offer and not heavily promoted, but it remains a useful security layer that supports the firm's core managed messaging services.
